About the Role
 

We are looking for a versatile and reliable Administrative & Finance Support Officer to join our Finance & Administration team.
 

This is not a role for an accounting specialist, nor are we searching for the next CFO of the group. Instead, we are looking for a well-organized administrative professional who is comfortable with numbers, has a practical mindset, and enjoys bringing structure and order to daily operations.
 

Key Responsibilities
 
 
 
• Processing and monitoring bank statements 
 
• Managing and reviewing expense reports 
 
• Verifying and following up on supplier invoices 
 
• Updating Excel files and internal databases 
 
• Document management and filing 
 
• Providing general administrative support to the Finance & Administration department 
 
• Contributing to the continuous improvement of administrative processes 

Your Profile
 
 
 
• Previous experience in an administrative, back-office, or financial support role 
 
• Experience working with an ERP system or integrated business software is a strong asset 
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft 365, particularly Excel, Outlook, and Teams 
 
• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills 
 
• Reliable and trustworthy professional attitude 
 
• Ability to work independently 
 
• Practical mindset and willingness to build a long-term career within the company 
 

We also appreciate people who ask questions when they don't know something rather than allowing the problem to mature quietly in their inbox.
 

 
 

Language Skills
 
 
 
• Good professional command of French and/or Dutch 
 
• Practical knowledge of English, allowing you to communicate by email, phone, and Microsoft Teams in a professional environment 
 
• Willingness to further develop your English skills as part of the role 
 

Being trilingual is certainly an advantage, but we are not necessarily looking for a simultaneous interpreter for the European Commission.

Location: KluisbergenIndustry: Rubber ManufacturingWork Schedule: 2 shifts (early & late)

We are a well-established rubber manufacturing company based in Kluisbergen, specialized in the production of high-quality rubber products for various industrial applications. Due to continued growth, we are looking for a motivated Production Operator to strengthen our team.
Your Responsibilities
• 
Operating and monitoring production machines

• 
Setting up machines according to production parameters

• 
Performing quality checks on finished products

• 
Identifying and reporting technical or production issues

• 
Ensuring a safe, clean, and organized working environment

Working closely with colleagues and supervisors to meet production targets

• 
You have first experience as an operator in a production environment

• 
Technical insight and willingness to learn

Ability to work accurately and independently

Good understanding of safety and quality standards

You are flexible and willing to work in a 2-shift system

Good knowledge of English (Dutch is a plus)

As a Junior International Account Manager, you will be responsible for developing and managing relationships with clients across international markets while identifying new business opportunities and driving growth.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Join a dynamic and fast-growing international company where innovation, entrepreneurship, and ambition are at the heart of everything. You'll have the opportunity to build a global network, make a real impact, and accelerate your career in an inspiring environment.

Omschrijving

• Build and maintain strong relationships with existing clients.
• Develop and manage your own client portfolio.
• Identify and approach new business opportunities.
• Understand clients' needs and provide tailored solutions.
• Conduct market research and monitor industry trends.
• Negotiate commercial agreements and close deals.
• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure excellent customer satisfaction.
• Represent the company during meetings, events, and client visits.

• Bachelor's degree minimum.
• Fluent in French or Dutch, with a good command of English.
• Ambitious, energetic, and driven by results.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Not afraid of client contact or commercial challenges.
• Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive attitude.
• Eager to learn and build a successful career in sales and account management.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL 

The Tribe Artificial Intelligence aims to deliver an efficient and seamless banking experience for our customers and empower our employees through AI. Our expert team of approximately 90 experts includes Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Business Analysts, Scrum Masters, Product Owners and Managers. We are seeking a Data Scientist with a minimum of 3 years of experience in developing AI applications, including both generative and predictive AI. 

 

AND IN DETAIL 

• You develop AI applications to address various business challenges, including virtual assistants to enhance client experiences, advanced AI tools to support employee efficiency and creativity, and automation to optimize internal processes. 
• You use various analytical methods, including large language models (Prompt Engineering, RAG, Fine-tuning), speech-to-text, agentic AI applications, image generation and interpretation, and classical statistical/machine learning techniques. While expertise in all areas is not required, strong proficiency in core technologies and the ability to learn new methods as needed are essential. 
• You contribute to deploying AI applications in production using a comprehensive stack of tools. 
• You access one of the richest volumes of varied data in the market and apply your skills to it. 
• You evolve in an environment where innovation and lean processes are praised, straight-forward communication is encouraged, and peers understand the meaning of team up. 
• You work with a team of colleagues in an Agile organization who are ready to collaborate and to share their experience. 

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES 

• You hold at least a Master’s degree in a quantitative field like statistics, computer science or engineering, with a focus on natural language processing. A PhD is advantageous. Candidates from other academic backgrounds with strong analytics knowledge are also welcome. 
• You have a minimum of 3 years' experience in data science, preferably in the financial sector, though less experience may be accepted if your academic achievements are substantial. 
• You are fluent in English and have a good command of French and/or Dutch. 
• You are proficient in Python for model building and understand ML engineering fundamentals (e.g., versioning systems) to produce code ready for CI/CD integration.

Do you have experience as a forklift driver and a valid forklift certificate?

Are you willing to work in shifts and in a fast-paced production environment?

This internationally growing production company specializes in innovative solutions for the construction and interior sector and is known for its strong focus on quality and sustainability. They are currently looking for forklift drivers to join their team in Desselgem in a stable and modern working environment.

What will you do?

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Transporting goods within the warehouse
• Supplying materials to the production lines
• SCanning and checking incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse clean and organized

• Forklift certificate
• Experience as a forklift driver
• Knowledge Dutch or English
• Willing to work in shifts

Our client, located in the Beveren region, is looking for a Supervisor Piping & Mechanical with strong technical expertise and people leadership skills.
 
 

• You’ll lead, coordinate and supervise daily piping and mechanical maintenance activities with a strong focus on HSE, quality, cost control and operational continuity 

• You’ll plan, prioritize and allocate maintenance work to ensure efficient execution of both preventive and corrective maintenance activities 

• You’ll organize daily toolbox meetings, communicate priorities and ensure compliance with all safety procedures and permit-to-work requirements 

• You’ll actively supervise field activities and provide technical support to technicians and contractors during the execution of maintenance work 

• You’ll coordinate closely with Operations, Engineering, Reliability and Inspection departments to align maintenance priorities and ensure efficient plant availability 

• You’ll ensure the safe and efficient execution of maintenance activities on piping systems, pressure vessels, heat exchangers, storage tanks and other static equipment 

• You’ll safeguard the mechanical integrity of plant assets by ensuring that maintenance and repair activities are executed according to engineering standards, site procedures and applicable regulations 

• You’ll support inspection programs and follow up on findings, integrity assessments, statutory inspections and corrective actions 

• You’ll coordinate and manage external contractors, ensuring compliance with safety, quality, planning and budget requirements 

• You’ll monitor work quality and verify that repairs, modifications and installations are completed according to specifications and industry standards 

• You’ll support the preparation, execution and evaluation of shutdowns, turnarounds and maintenance projects 

• You’ll drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on reliability, safety, efficiency and maintenance performance 

• You’ll ensure accurate maintenance administration and reporting in SAP, including work order completion, time registration and maintenance history 
 

• You have a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical qualification, or equivalent by experience 

• You have at least 5 years of relevant maintenance experience within the petrochemical, chemical, oil & gas or related process industry 

• You’re experienced in a supervisory, team leader or coordination role within an industrial environment 

• You have solid knowledge of piping systems, pressure equipment, heat exchangers, storage tanks and other static equipment 

• You have a good understanding of mechanical integrity principles, inspection methodologies and reliability-driven maintenance practices 

• You have a strong knowledge of HSE requirements, permit-to-work systems, contractor management and process safety 

• You’re experienced with SAP or another CMMS system and good proficiency in Microsoft Office applications 

• You own strong planning, organizational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to effectively manage changing priorities 

• You have excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, enabling effective collaboration across multiple disciplines 

• You are fluent in Dutch and have a good command of English 

• You have a hands-on leadership style with the ability to motivate, coach and develop people

Our client is a leading international retail organization operating across multiple countries. This company is investing heavily in the modernization and optimization of its technology landscape, with SAP playing a central role in supporting business operations and future growth.As part of its ongoing digital transformation journey, the organization is strengthening its SAP Retail team to enhance business processes, improve operational efficiency, and support strategic initiatives across procurement, supply chain, inventory management, pricing, and store operations.As IT SAP Retail Consultant, you will join a team of experienced professionals working closely with stakeholders across business and IT functions to deliver impactful solutions that support the organization's long-term ambitions.

As Senior SAP Retail Business Consultant, you will be responsible for supporting, optimizing, and evolving SAP Retail solutions across the end-to-end retail value chain.Your key responsibilities will include:

• Supporting and enhancing SAP Retail business processes across procurement, inventory management, assortment management, pricing, replenishment, logistics, and store operations.
• Gathering business requirements and translating them into functional specifications and effective SAP solutions.
• Configuring SAP Retail functionalities and ensuring alignment with SAP best practices.
• Driving process standardization and continuous improvement initiatives across business units and countries.
• Providing 2nd and 3rd line functional support, investigating incidents, identifying root causes, and coordinating issue resolution.
• Contributing to SAP transformation and S/4HANA-related projects by participating in workshops, solution design activities, testing, and deployment initiatives.
• Collaborating with business users, project teams, implementation partners, and external service providers.
• Supporting system integrations with eCommerce platforms, warehouse management solutions, financial applications, POS systems, EDI interfaces, and other third-party solutions.
• Assisting data migration activities and promoting data quality and governance best practices.
• Acting as a trusted advisor for business stakeholders while mentoring junior team members and facilitating knowledge transfer.
• Ensuring the stability, performance, and long-term sustainability of SAP Retail solutions

To succeed in this role, you will combine strong SAP Retail expertise with excellent stakeholder management and problem-solving capabilities.You ideally bring:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Supply Chain, or a related field.
• At least 8 years of SAP experience, including a minimum of 5 years focused on SAP Retail.
• Proven experience working within large-scale retail organizations and complex international environments.
• Strong expertise in:
• SAP Retail
• SAP MM
• SAP SD
• Assortment Management
• Article Master Data
• Purchasing Processes
• Inventory Management
• Invoice Verification
• Retail Pricing
• Exposure to SAP S/4HANA Retail, SAP CAR, SAP Datasphere, SAP BTP, or SAP Integration Suite would be considered a strong advantage.
• Solid understanding of retail and supply chain business processes.
• Experience in solution design, requirements gathering, testing, and change management.
• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
• Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.
• The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
• Fluency in English and either French or Dutch.

Are you the Incident Manager we’re looking for?

We are looking for an experienced Incident / Problem Manager to join an Application Support team based in Brussels.

You will play a key role in managing application-related incidents and problems, with a strong focus on reducing recurring incidents, improving service stability, and driving continuous improvement.

You will join a small, collaborative team and work closely with technical and application support teams to ensure incidents are effectively managed, root causes are identified, and appropriate corrective actions are implemented.
Role
• Manage the end-to-end Incident Management process for application-related incidents.
• Lead and coordinate the Problem Management process, including root cause analysis and corrective actions.
• Monitor and follow up on application-related incidents, ensuring appropriate prioritisation and resolution.
• Identify trends and recurring incidents and implement actions to reduce incident volumes.
• Support the management of incidents across different priority levels, including P3–P4.
• Monitor application environments using Datadog.
• Work with ServiceNow for incident and problem management.
• Analyse incident trends and identify opportunities for service improvement.
• Collaborate with application, infrastructure, and technical teams to resolve complex issues.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of application support and IT service management processes.
• Participate in an on-call rotation, currently expected to be approximately one week in three. Out-of-hours incident volumes are currently low.
Profile
We are looking for someone with a backgound Incident Management, Problem Management, or Application Support experience.

You should have:

• Proven experience in Incident Management and/or Problem Management or Support engineering. .
• Previous experience within an Application Support environment.
• Experience working with ServiceNow.
• Experience with Datadog or a similar monitoring solution.
• Good working knowledge of SQL.
• A hands-on approach and the ability to work closely with technical teams.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Good communication and stakeholder-management skills.
• The ability to work effectively in a small, collaborative team.
• Fluent/professional English.

You will be modelling a highly diverse set of treatment processes and plants for water industry
 

clients worldwide, with the goal of reducing greenhouse gas emissions, improving waterquality,
 

saving resources and making plants smart. By mastering and applying modelling techniques such
 

as bio/chemical kinetics, computational fluid dynamics (CFD) or the combination, you will unravel
 

what is happening inside water treatment systems and will be able to improve processes
 

significantly. After a while, you will be able to execute rather spectacular modelling work, for which
 

AM-Team is known. The complexity of the modelling projects will grow along with and will be
 

adjusted to your modelling knowledge and experience. You will also be developing a broad
 

knowledge on existing and novel industry processes.
 

The objectives of your modelling projects will be highly case dependent, but mostly you will make
 

clients happy by saving costs, saving energy, improving technology and competitive position,
 

accelerating technology development, and improving process performance and reliability.
 

Main responsibilities
 

• 
Project execution & delivery: Executing multiple modelling projects & delivery of the
 

project outcomes to the customers in the shape of reports and presentations. Typically,
 

projects execution involves. 2/3
 

Job offering – Solution Engineer
 

o Understanding project objectives & gathering relevant data
 

o Planning project milestones and executing projects in a stepwise & collaborative
 

manner.
 

o Organizing client meetings and preparing presentations & reports.
 

o Supporting other team members with expert knowledge.
 

• 
Technical communication & dissemination: Internal & external communication on
 

projects and at international events or in online webinars. Writing technical abstracts,
 

journal articles and social media technical blogs or posts.
 

• 
Research & development: Developing new modelling solutions tailored to market needs
 

in close collaboration with the team. Creating templates and SOPs for existing modelling
 

methods.
 

• 
Coaching & training: Continuous learning & improving through active trainings. Also
 

coaching others.
 

You will be guided by senior colleagues at the start and will gradually grow and do your work more
 

autonomously.

• Has at least 2-3 years of water or wastewater industry or relevant academic experience
 

related to working with modelling projects.
 

• Has at least MSc in (environmental/bioscience or relevant) engineering. Has strong
 

understanding and educational background of water treatment processes and/or
 

modelling of these processes. Knowledge and experience with CFD modelling is a plus.
 

• Deeply shares AM-Team’s core values.
 

o We value the fun factor: working with us makes you smile and makes us smile.
 

o Why should the sky be the limit? You are a person that is not afraid to think out of
 

the box and set ambitious goals.
 

o A team is so much more than a bunch of individuals: you are a true team player.
 

o We tailor to enhance value but fit for purpose: we stand for quality and the tailoring
 

of our approach to our team and customers.
 

o We have no boundary conditions: we have no geographical, cultural, or technical
 

boundaries.
 

o We never settle, and keep stirring, we want to infinitely learn and improve, both as
 

team and individuals
 

• Is interested in the wonder world of digitalisation and has passion for innovation.
 

• Is eager to learn and curious.
 

• Has ability to ask the right questions and carefully listen to clients to help them maximally
 

and truly understand their needs and problems.
 

• Has good (self) organisational skills and takes initiative.
 

• Has good presentation skills and can explain things simply, even when they are complex.
 

• Is fluent in English both written and orally - knowledge of another language is a plus (e.g.
 

Dutch, French, or German).

A technical role that makes models and digital twins deliver lasting value at the global scale
 

We’re looking for a water-passioned person that loves combining the water and wastewater
 

treatment side with data, models and digital twins. This role focuses on translating models and
 

data into real value for end customers at the global scale. Beyond the buzz. You will be working
 

in our technical team and will also be interacting regularly with our sales team.

• Has at least 3 years of water or wastewater industry or relevant academic experience related
 

to working with data, mechanistic modelling or hybrid modelling projects.
 

• Has an MSc in (environmental/bioscience or relevant) engineering. Has strong understanding of water treatment processes and associated modelling / data handling of those.
 

• Preferably has specific expertise in data science applications for (waste)water treatment
 

• Is willing to be working from our office in Ghent, Belgium
 

• Has good communication skills and can explain complex matter to customers
 

• Is fluent in English, both written and orally - knowledge of another language is a plus
 

• Shares our company values
 
 

• Transformative digital thought leadership: With the work we do, we don’t just create impact and improve things. We transform the water industry by providing cutting-edge digital solutions. 

• Innovation that solves: We dare to push boundaries and see innovation as a necessity in today’s world. However, dreaming is not enough. Practicality matters as well. Innovative thinking + practicality = impact 

• Together we are one team and pursue shared ambitions: A team is much more than a bunch of individuals. We believe we need people that are different in skills and similar in values to achieve big things

We are looking for an enthusiastic sorting assistant for a company in Zulte that specializes in sorting and distributing clothing!

We are looking for a motivated sorting assistant to join our team.

In this position, you will be responsible for sorting various materials and processing them correctly.

What will you be doing?

• Sorting second-hand clothing into different qualities.
• Working at a good pace – you are dynamic and accurate.
• No allergies to dust and no physical complaints.
• You preferably live nearby or you have a car

What are our expectations?

• Knowledge of Dutch or English is required.
• Willingness to perform physical work.
• You are not allergic to dust!
• You are not colourblind!
• Accuracy and attention to detail.
• You are looking for a long-term job.
• You live close to Zulte or you have a car
• You are motivated and enjoy working in a team.

As a Recruitment Consultant, you will operate as a true 360° consultant, managing both client relationships and candidate processes. This role combines recruitment expertise with a strong commercial focus and offers the opportunity to develop your own market and portfol

Client Details

Michael Page is a globally recognised recruitment consultancy specialising in the placement of qualified professionals and managers across a wide range of sectors, including Finance, Human Resources, Sales & Marketing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Digital & Technology, Legal, and more.

As part of our continued growth in Belgium, we are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to join our Brussels office and contribute to our success while building their own professional career.

Description
Business Development & Sales
• Identify and prospect new business opportunities within your market.
• Develop and manage a portfolio of clients across different industries.
• Conduct client meetings to understand hiring needs and business challenges.
• Negotiate commercial agreements and recruitment partnerships.
• Build long-term relationships with key decision-makers and HR stakeholders.
• Become a trusted advisor for your clients regarding talent acquisition and market trends.Recruitment & Talent Acquisition
• Manage the full recruitment lifecycle from briefing to placement.
• Source and engage top talent through LinkedIn, job boards, networking, and referrals.
• Conduct interviews and assess candidates' skills, experience, and motivations.
• Present qualified candidates to clients and manage the interview process.
• Deliver an exceptional candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey.
• Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline within your specialisation.Client Relationship Management
• Act as the main point of contact for your clients.
• Provide market insights and salary benchmarking.
• Ensure a high level of service and client satisfaction.
• Develop long-term partnerships based on trust and expertise.
 

• Previous experience in sales, business development, recruitment, consulting, customer service, or a commercial role.
• Strong interest in business development and client relationship management.
• Entrepreneurial mindset and passion for achieving results.
• Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
• Resilient, ambitious, and motivated by targets and performance.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
• Fluent in French and English or Dutch and English.
• Fluency in French, Dutch, and English is considered a significant advantage.

For this fast-growing Belgian company with various subsidiaries in Europe, we are currently looking for an accountant to join an experienced finance department.
 

In this role, you are in charge of a portfolio of projects at various stages of development. You will be responsible for all accounting, tax (in cooperation with an external accounting & tax consultancy) and administrative requirements.
 

The job is based in Olen.
 

 
 

Accountant – The Role:
 

- 
 Review the booking of various invoices (AP/AR/bank statements)
 

- 
 Prepare the month- and year-end closings, as well as the annual accounts
 

- 
 Prepare the monthly VAT return, as well at the corporate tax return
 

- 
 Regular reporting to the company’s Finance Manager
 

 

Accountant – About You:
 

- 
 You have obtained a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting
 

- 
 You have at least 2 years of experience in a similar role
 

- 
 You are fluent in Dutch & English

As a Accountant, you will monitor, analyse, and report key expense categories while ensuring accurate financial reporting and effective cost control. Acting as a business partner to various departments, you will provide valuable insights that support operational efficiency and strategic decision-making.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

This position is within the property industry and based near Ternat.

Omschrijving

Reporting to the Accounting Manager, your responsibilities will include:

• Monitoring and analysing operational expenses and project-related costs.
• Managing and overseeing the invoice and purchase order cycle.
• Reviewing accounting entries, allocations, and VAT-related controls.
• Supporting month-end and year-end closing activities, including accruals, reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.
• Performing variance analysis and preparing financial reporting for key stakeholders.
• Supporting budgeting, forecasting, and audit processes.
• Ensuring compliance with accounting standards and internal control procedures.
• Contributing to process improvements, financial systems enhancements, and European-wide projects.
• Collaborating with internal stakeholders to drive transparency, efficiency, and cost optimisation.
• Supporting knowledge-sharing and collaboration within the finance team.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or equivalent experience.
• Minimum 4-5 years of experience in accounting or financial reporting.
• Previous experience within a services, retail, or similar operational environment.
• Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial controls.
• Experience with SAP; S4Hana knowledge is considered a strong asset.
• Advanced Excel skills.
• Good knowledge of IFRS and/or local GAAP standards is an advantage.
• Fluent English communication skills; additional European languages are a plus.
• Analytical, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset.
• Comfortable working in an international and fast-paced environment

For a company in the meat industry Oudenaarde, we are looking for an All-round Technician.

What will your responsibilities be?

• You will be responsible for corrective, preventive and improvement-oriented maintenance of the machinery, equipment and buildings. 
• You will carry out scheduled maintenance and perform the necessary repairs. 
• You will ensure the production machinery operates optimal.

Who are you?

• You are able to identify and resolve technical faults. 
• You have a good command of either Dutch or English.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

You will work on a day schedule, on different projects and at various locations, with a salary between €17 and €19 per hour, plus additional benefits.

 
• 
Install plastic walls, pipes and connection components.

Carry out hot-air welding work.

 
• 
Install fastening elements and ensure the work is finished neatly.

 
• 
Assist with basement fitting and the installation of wall and facade cladding.

 
• 
Help position installations using a crane.

 
• 
Perform simple electrical work, such as pulling cables.

You enjoy working outdoors and at different locations.

 
• 
You pay attention to correct installation and proper finishing of the work.

 
• 
You enjoy learning new things.

 
• 
Experience in the field is an advantage, but not required.

 
• 
You do not need prior knowledge of plastic welding, as this is taught within the company.

 
• 
You speak English.

Do you have a solid experience as a CE Truck Driver and enjoy delivering items from point A to point B? Then this might be exactly the opportunity you're looking for! We're looking for a reliable professional who takes pride in delivering vehicles in perfect condition.
In this role, you will take charge of transporting various vehicles, including vans and trucks, to different destinations. 

 
• Safely loading, securing, and unloading vehicles. 
Checking the load, transport documentation, and ensuring everything is delivered correctly. 

 
• Keeping the truck, trailer, and all equipment well-maintained and in top condition.

•  
A precise, safety-focused way of working. 

 
•  
Proficiency in Dutch or English (French is a plus) 

 
•  
A friendly, professional communication style and appearance.

Flexibility: your schedule won't always be a standard 9-to-5; starting earlier or finishing later is part of the job.

Do you enjoy technical work and want to see the tangible result of what you build? As an electrical installer, you will be responsible for setting up technical control rooms in the workshop and will work with both electrical components and plastic installations.

You will work on a day schedule, in a modern workshop, with a salary between €17 and €19 per hour, depending on your experience.

 
• 
Install pumps, pipes and measuring equipment.

Carry out electrical work such as pulling cables, installing cable trays, and connecting devices and electrical panels.

 
• 
Drill holes and install PVC, PP and PE connection pipes and couplings.

 
• 
Work based on technical diagrams and plans.

You have knowledge of electricity and can read electrical diagrams.

You can work based on technical plans and diagrams.

 
• 
You enjoy working with your hands and seeing the tangible results of your work.

 
• 
You are interested in different types of technical work and practical activities.

You pay attention to correct execution and proper finishing.

 
• 
You speak English.

BMSvision is not just another tech company; they are your go-to partner for Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) in the discrete manufacturing industry, with a specific focus on the textile, plastics and packaging industries. Their highly skilled R&D experts are passionate about developing top-notch hardware and software solutions that register productivity, quality and energy consumption data. This empowers their customers to fine-tune their operations for optimal efficiency.

Established in 2008 as a spin-off by Barco and currently part of the Vandewiele group, the BMSvision team has gained substantial experience learning from a large installed base in the plastics and textile industry. Their MES-solutions seamlessly integrate with ERP systems, addressing the requirements of Industry 4.0 and the broader Smart Factory landscape.

They’ve established their presence in Belgium (HQ), the UK, the US, China, India, Malaysia and Turkey. Additionally, they’ve built a worldwide network of agents and service centers.

Jobomschrijving

Drive international growth by helping manufacturers succeed in their Industry 4.0 journey

• You will be responsible for selling MES-systems to B2B customers in the global growth markets of textiles and plastics.
• You focus on medium and large enterprises and you'll speak to strategic decision makers (owners, general management, IT and production management).
• In the countries where you operate, you will work together with sales agents. You research the market potential of your countries, select quality partners with a good reputation, evaluate their activities and visit prospects whose doors they will open.
• You are responsible for preparing offers, launching marketing campaigns and making presentations.
• You participate in national and international fairs.
• You think along with the customer and convince them that BMS is their suitable partner for their Industry 4.0 strategy.

• You hold a technical or technical/economic master’s degree or you've built up equivalent expertise through experience and you have a strong affinity with software-driven solutions.
• Ideally, you bring around 10 years of experience in Sales or Business Development, preferably within the manufacturing industry, where you have successfully positioned business operations or MES-related software.
• You feel at ease collaborating with stakeholders at different levels and you have a proven track record in complex, project-driven sales environments with longer sales cycles.
• You love to travel internationally frequently and you are interested in other cultures.
• You communicate fluently in English and any additional language skills, such as French, German, Italian, etc., are a strong asset.
• Continuous learning energizes you. You enjoy negotiating, building long-term relationships and taking ownership.
• You combine an entrepreneurial mindset with strong self-management skills, all within a collaborative corporate culture where pragmatism, intrapreneurship and responsibility truly matter.

Are you passionate about cybersecurity, threat detection, and defending organizations against evolving cyber threats?

We are looking for a Cyber Security Analyst to join a leading international cybersecurity organization in Belgium. You’ll work alongside experienced security professionals, using modern technologies and security frameworks to detect, investigate, and respond to cyber incidents.
Role
As a Cyber Security Analyst, you will be responsible for monitoring security environments, investigating potential threats, and supporting customers during security incidents.

Key responsibilities include:

• Triage and investigate alerts generated by SIEM, EDR/endpoint protection, network detection, and other security tools
• Conduct threat hunting investigations and campaigns
• Escalate relevant threats to customers and provide actionable security advice
• Identify anomalies and attack patterns across the MITRE ATT&CK framework
• Support customers during security incidents and contribute to effective incident response
• Continuously improve detection rules, processes, and investigation methodologies
• Support onboarding projects for new customers
• Prepare and deliver monthly security reports on customer environments
ProfileWhat We're Looking For
• Full professional proficiency in English
• Conversational knowledge of Dutch and French
• Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Digital Forensics, Engineering, or equivalent industry-recognized certification/relevant experience
• Initial hands-on experience in Cyber Security Operations, ideally within a Blue Team/SOC environment
• Understanding of:
• Threat hunting
• Incident detection & response
• Penetration testing concepts
• Malware analysis
• Strong analytical and investigative skills
• Customer-oriented mindset and ability to communicate technical topics to both technical and non-technical audiences
• Structured, process-oriented approach with strong attention to detail
• Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies and security solutionsNice to Have
• Experience with SIEM, SOAR, EDR, sandboxing, honeypots, or endpoint protection
• Knowledge of AI and security automation
• Cybersecurity/SOC-related certifications
